comment: Where a file of the renamed baseline (eng/upstream/baseline-tree.txt) lives in Styml when it is not at its renamed path, and the upstream areas that Styml replaced with YAML code. Maintained by hand; read by eng/upstream/status and eng/upstream/sync.

moved.comment: Renamed-baseline path -> Styml path. The sync merges upstream changes into the Styml file.

removed.comment: Renamed-baseline path -> why Styml has no counterpart. Upstream changes to these files are reported for a person to judge, never merged.

replaced_areas.why: the JSON reader: lexer, number parsing, string unescaping, depth and size limits. Styml's YAML grammar replaces the lexer, so a fix here may need an equivalent in Utf8YamlReader.Yaml*.cs.
code built on the JSON token stream (document parsing, unescaping helpers, limits, reader scoping) that Styml changed for YAML scalars and collections.
the JSON writer: escaping and number formatting. Styml's block style (Utf8YamlWriter.Block*.cs) writes the same values another way and may need the same fix.
